blocks.text: Kisi compound ki lattice energy ek seedhe tajurbe se tai nahi ho sakti, magar kai tajurbati data se Born-Haber cycle naami energy cycle se nikali ja sakti hai, jo Hess ke qanoon ka istemal hai.

blocks.alt: Teen halke neele dabbon ka tikon: Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) (oopar baen), Na+Cl-(s) (oopar daen) aur Na+(g) + Cl-(g) (neeche). Oopar baen se oopar daen teer: delta H(o)f. Anasir se neeche gaseous ions tak teer: delta Hx. Gaseous ions se oopar Na+Cl-(s) tak teer: delta H(o)latt.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.8: Sodium chloride ka enthalpy cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.8 mein oopar daen dabba 'Na+Cl-(g)' chhapa hai aur delta H(o)latt ka teer solid se gaseous ions ki taraf hai. Lattice energy gaseous ions se solid banne ki tabdeeli hai, is liye yahan dabba Na+Cl-(s) aur teer gaseous ions se solid ki taraf durust kiya gaya hai. Tab hi delta Hx + delta H(o)latt = delta H(o)f banta hai.

Sodium chloride ke liye anasir Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) seedhe solid NaCl banate hain (delta Hf, standard enthalpy of formation, calorimeter mein asani se napi jati hai) ya gaseous ions Na+(g) + Cl-(g) se guzarte hain: delta Hx sodium aur chlorine ko un ki standard states se gaseous ions mein badalne ki kul energy hai, aur gaseous ions phir solid banate hain (delta Hlatt). Hess ke qanoon se delta Hx + delta Hlatt = delta Hf.
Delta Hx ke marahil dikhane ke liye phailaya hua energy tikon mukammal Born-Haber cycle hai.

blocks.alt: Born-Haber energy seerhi (paimane par nahi). Mote reactants level Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) se: delta Hat of Na = +108 kJ mol-1 oopar Na(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g) tak; delta Hi of Na = +496 oopar Na+(g) + e- + 1/2 Cl2(g) tak; delta Hat of Cl2 = +121 oopar Na+(g) + e- + Cl(g) tak; delta Hea of Cl = -349 neeche Na+(g) + Cl-(g) tak; phir mota teer neeche, delta Hlatt of Na+Cl-(s) = ? (NaCl ki lattice energy), aakhri product Na+Cl-(s) tak. Reactants se seedha teer neeche Na+Cl-(s) tak: delta Hf = -411 kJ mol-1.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.9: Sodium chloride ka Born-Haber cycle (paimane ke mutabiq nahi) (kitab ki Figure 6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seerhi mein har qadam ek tabdeeli hai: sodium ka atom banna (+108), us ka ion banna (+496), chlorine ka atom banna (+121) aur chlorine ka electron lena (-349). Kitab mein do level ghalat chhape hain: pehle qadam ke baad 'Na+(g) + 1/2 Cl2' (durust: Na(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g)) aur sab se oopar 'Cl2(g)' (durust: Cl(g)). Upar jao to energy jazb, neeche aao to kharij; dono raste barabar hain, is liye lattice energy = -411 - 376 = -787 kJ mol-1.

blocks.caption: NaCl ka Born-Haber cycle (Figure 6.9), kJ fi mol
rows: Lattice energy = delta Hf - delta Hx

blocks.text: Sample Problem 6.9: sodium fluoride, jo sodium chloride lattice mein crystallize hota hai, ki heat of formation us ke cycle se. Na(s) ki heat of atomization 109, F2 ki aadhi bond energy 79, sodium ki ionization energy 494, fluorine ki electron affinity -328 aur lattice energy -939 kJ fi mol hai: delta Hf = -939 + 109 + 494 + 79 - 328 = -585 kJ fi mol.

blocks.prompt: Lithium fluoride ki heat of formation nikalein: Li(s) ki atomization 161, F2 ki aadhi bond energy 79, lithium ki ionization 520, fluorine ki electron affinity -328, lattice energy -1107 kJ fi mol (print mein nishan ke baghair).
blocks.explanation: Delta Hf = delta Hlatt + delta Hat(Li) + IE(Li) + delta Hat(F) + EA(F) = -1107 + 161 + 520 + 79 - 328 = -675 kJ fi mol.

items: Born-Haber cycle: ionic solid par Hess ka qanoon; delta Hx (atomizations + ionization + electron affinity) + delta Hlatt = delta Hf. NaCl: 108 + 496 + 121 - 349 = +376; lattice energy = -411 - 376 = -787 kJ fi mol. NaF formation: -939 + 109 + 494 + 79 - 328 = -585 kJ fi mol.
